serve.quant: EXL3 uniform 2.9bpw mul1 (~197 GiB, 39 shards) + native Engram tables (shards 47/48, slim-hardlinked)

decode.protocol: temp 0, thinking off, 400 tokens, median of 5

prefill_ladder.note: unique-salt cold prompts; this profile pins MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS=1536 / LONG_PREFILL_TOKEN_THRESHOLD=1280, so long-prompt ingest is intentionally conservative; run aborted by the memory guard at the 32k rung
prefill_ladder.abort_reason: host MemAvailable fell below the guard floor at the 32k rung under the 0.84 UMA envelope; longer rungs skipped

vision_quality.note: the 47-field menu truth is production data and is not published; only scores, timings, and method are. An earlier same-day run at GPU_MEM_UTIL 0.86 scored menu off 38/47 before an unrelated host-memory abort, cross-confirming the score.

agent_real_tasks.framework: hermes agent loop, thinking=low, 3 frozen cron tasks
agent_real_tasks.note: task names/inputs are production prompts and are not published; per-task walls and server-side deltas only

boot_history_note: six pre-success attempts across two root causes (stale worker rank container pinning ~112 GiB after a crash; skip of the slim Engram staging step) plus one host-memory abort at GPU_MEM_UTIL 0.86 before the 0.84 profile completed clean; all fixes folded into scripts/window-step.sh
raw_receipts: high-precision per-run JSONs live on the benchmarking host; this file is the publishable aggregate
